mapper.sql: select id, name, parent_id, password, `order`, del_flag, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from px_note_folder
mapper.select: with recursive folder_tree as ( select id as root_id, id as sub_id from px_note_folder where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 union all select ft.root_id, f.id as sub_id from px_note_folder f inner join folder_tree ft on f.parent_id = ft.sub_id where f.del_flag = 0 ) select f.id, f.name, f.parent_id, f.password, f.`order`, f.del_flag, f.version, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, f.remark, coalesce(notes.cnt, 0) as note_count from px_note_folder f left join ( select root_id, count(*) as cnt from folder_tree ft inner join px_note n on ft.sub_id = n.folder and n.del_flag = 0 group by root_id ) notes on f.id = notes.root_id where f.id = #{id}
